newsitem.title: FRANCE: 12 Algerians, including women, children, murdered.
newsitem.headline: 12 Algerians, including women, children, murdered.

text.p: Twelve Algerians, including four women and three children, were killed in a raid on a village near the garrison town of Blida, south of Algiers, overnight, Algerian security forces said on Wednesday.

In a statement on the official Algerian news agency APS, the security forces said the 12 were "assassinated in a cowardly way" - the term Algerian authorities use for civilians killed by having their throats cut by Moslem fundamentalists.
